protocol.kind: Retrospective audit of original saved forecasts, NOT an untouched holdout
protocol.selection: All available original main-market numeric OVER/UNDER probabilities with valid pregame saved/forecast timestamps, exact matching line and fixture older than four hours. Select without grade, outcome, side or confidence filtering. Earliest saved decision per market/fixture/player.
protocol.benchmark: Constant 0.5 conditional probability only; no two-sided market prices available in this source, so no no-vig book or ROI claim.
protocol.sourceCoverage: Report source coverage; missing finals/player statistics remain unresolved, never zero.

limitations: Retrospective diagnosis, not a fresh holdout or proof of improved model.
Players within the same fixture are correlated.
Constant 0.5 is not a no-vig sportsbook benchmark; no odds/ROI claim.
No original forecast, historical result or live model is modified.
